name: Australis class — 2030 concept
hull_deck_join: upper hull shares the full flight-deck underside perimeter
bow_shape: high continuous flared topsides with a narrowing faceted lower bow and fine waterline stem; hydrodynamics unverified
propulsion_design_target: Nuclear power; eight conceptual waterjets, native conventional propulsion approximation

islands.main: larger integrated command and sensor island amidships
islands.aft: 20% narrower, 35% shorter and 28% lower aft aviation island, with glazing on all six bridge faces

deck.aft_spot_use: Three helicopter/VTOL pads; actual rotor clearances and mixed flight cycles require in-game QA
deck.aft_spot_layout: Front, middle beside rear tower, and aft; helicopter preference aft, front, middle
deck.lift_reference_aircraft: Stock F-14A; full-span footprint and stock deck-reference offset

deck.layout: Two bow and one angled port-waist catapult
deck.catapult_visual_details: Deck-flush metal tracks, thin dark slots and painted guides, compact launch shuttles and flush segmented stowed deflectors; static geometry
deck.aircraft_eligibility: Automatic installed carrier-capable aircraft discovery; no class, size, role or loadout exclusions
deck.aircraft_compatibility_limit: Reference footprints checked; swept taxi turns, rotor envelopes, loadouts and mixed deck cycles require in-game testing
deck.lift_layout: Two forward fixed-wing lifts; two rear helicopter/VTOL lifts
